description: The identity translation agrees in truth with the original shared formula at every assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InterpretingTheories.InterpretationData.identity_translation.{u, v, w, z}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {N : Type w} [L.Structure N] {α : Type z} (A : L.Formula α) (v : α → N) :
  ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InterpretingTheories.InterpretationData.identity L).translate A).Realize v ↔
    A.Realize v
